projects.title: The Happy Chirp
projects.description:
A short termed spin-off by IPKO, one of the largest telecom companies in Kosova, was intended to attract a specific audience that would not be bothered with the complexities of choosing the right mobile package deal.

The client requested from us to launch a very simple, no-frills brand, with one set price for calls, SMS and internet, that would easily appeal to the audience that they had yet to reach. 

We named and created a simple, unique three lettered brand called Zog (Bird) in yellow, white and black, conveying a simple message using a cheerful family of birds, through various animations…
